_meta.doc: Edits here change runtime behaviour. The rule set is loaded at EthicsEngine.__init__ via ETHICS_RULES_PATH or config/ethics_rules.json by default. Schema is mirrored from src/monitoring/ethics_engine.py:_map_category and the EthicsRule dataclass.

schema.category: one of: mission_ethics, resource_ethics, ai_ethics, safety, transparency, fairness
schema.severity: one of: low, medium, high, critical
schema.auto_block: true means the engine signals callers to refuse the action; false means flag-and-continue
schema.conditions: list of free-form strings evaluated by EthicsEngine._check_condition; matched against ActionContext attributes via simple comparison parsing

rules.name: Life Safety Priority
rules.description: Actions must not create risk to human safety

rules.name: Human Oversight Required
rules.description: Critical decisions must have human oversight
